item: Row J final read: every briefing producer counts outlets, a refused outlet holds a shipped qualified verdict, a refused merge no longer counts as merged
refs: R153; R146; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: The last read of the J3 head found five briefing producers carrying a feed label where a card counts voices; they now carry the outlet key, and the group paths name outlets. The qualification overlay no longer lifts a shipped qualified verdict onto a feed whose outlet has a disqualified feed (counted as held_by_outlet_disqualified, logged at boot). The seeder report counts a feed-less tag merge onto a held-back feed as held back, and a standing refusal means one made at an earlier boot. The outlet-count scan now follows a set bound to a name, wrapped in sorted(), or built by add, and classifies corpus_coordination as a named limit.
